blue.lllIlI1l1llI11I1.android:summary: Disables all Live streaming features, and prevents your last seen time and country from being updated.\nDisabling Kik Live will reduce spam bot PMs.

blue.lII1l11II11llIlI.android:summary: Change the "About Me" section on your Kik Live profile

blue.I1IllIIll1Il1I1I.android:title: Video Frame Rate
blue.I1IllIIll1Il1I1I.android:summary: Change video frame rate while streaming

blue.lllIlI1l1llI11I1.android:summary: Join streams without being detected by other users\n\nNote: the stream chat won't work while this is on

blue.lllIlI1l1llI11I1.android:title: Disable Live Notifications

blue.lllIlI1l1llI11I1.android:title: Hide Next Date

blue.lllIlI1l1llI11I1.android:title: Show Platform Indicators
blue.lllIlI1l1llI11I1.android:summary: If enabled, an icon will be shown for streamers and chatters depending on the app they are using.\nThis is subject to removal in future updates, as Kik is the only platform.
